scope: Two local headless Chrome pages attach the portable A2 peer to a direct reliable ordered RTCDataChannel and exchange the existing start-identity hello. The portable peer sends its two neutral bootstrap records to an explicit test sink. No native runtime or gameplay rendering is loaded.

captured_source_identity.basis: The staged bytes, captured producer bytes, and current rebased integration bytes have the same SHA-256 for both portable modules.

test_integration_change.change: Add tests/net_lockstep_webrtc.test.mjs to the existing Node test list used by Python unittest discovery.

implementation_contract.endpoint: createDataChannelEndpoint adapts an already-created RTCDataChannel. It requires ordered delivery and unset retransmission limits, installs receive/error/close listeners synchronously, bounds inbound/outbound queues, and retains terminal/close errors.
implementation_contract.protocol: The existing portable LockstepPeer hello/state protocol is reused unchanged; send-buffer drain is not treated as a remote acknowledgement.

attachment.alpha: Endpoint attaches immediately after createDataChannel; readyState is connecting at attachment.
attachment.beta: The datachannel listener is registered before setRemoteDescription and attaches the endpoint synchronously in that event; readyState is open before the event fires.

implementation_contract.signaling: The beta page creates and returns its answer after applying the offer. Alpha applies the answer before the coordinator waits for beta attachment, avoiding an attachment-before-answer wait.

transport.signaling: In-memory offer/answer descriptions after host candidate gathering.

sink.native_api_call_claim: Not applicable: the probe did not load native runtime JavaScript or WebAssembly.
sink.records: Exact neutral bootstrap records observed at the portable test sink; no native frame was submitted.

webgpu_metadata.scope_note: Metadata was recorded from the CSS fixture; no game rendering or GPU correctness assertion was made.

v1.outcome: Stopped in root review before launch. Review found that beta waited for datachannel attachment before creating its answer and that the readyState assertion incorrectly expected beta to be connecting.
v1.retention_note: The v1 packet, manifest, and self-review metadata remain; the staged v1 runner and page probe files were overwritten for v2. No reconstructed v1 source bytes are represented as retained.

v2.outcome: One authorized local headless browser run passed; no failed browser run occurred.

dirty_test_patch.change: One line adds tests/net_lockstep_webrtc.test.mjs to the SDK Node test invocation.

current_main_validation.focused_node_command: python3 scripts/agent_workspace.py run -- .deps/emsdk/node/24.19.0_64bit/bin/node --test tests/net_lockstep_webrtc.test.mjs tests/net_lockstep_core.test.mjs tests/net_lockstep_browser_peer.test.mjs tests/net_lockstep_transport.test.mjs

focused_python_wrapper.command: python3 scripts/agent_workspace.py run -- python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_net_lockstep_contracts.py -v

full_python_suite.command: python3 scripts/agent_workspace.py run -- python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

current_main_validation.native_build: Not required; the component and test integration changes are JavaScript/Python test dispatch and documentation only. No C/C++ runtime file changed.

claims: The existing A2 portable core works with the reviewed browser WebRTC endpoint in two local headless Chrome pages.
The browser-owned endpoint exchanges the existing A2 identity hello over a reliable ordered local DataChannel.
The v2 CSS-only probe reaches the explicit portable test sink with two exact neutral bootstrap records per peer.
Current-main rebase preserves the captured portable core and WebRTC endpoint bytes; the full suite now executes the new WebRTC unit file through unittest discovery.
exclusions: native runtime execution, native frame submission, or gameplay input sampling
Internet, hosted signaling, TURN, relay fallback, or two-machine acceptance
foreground timing, latency, performance, or sustained behavior
game rendering, pixel accuracy, PCM/audio-output acceptance, or full supported route
complete A3, rollback, tournament, or whole-session acceptance
